package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
)

// scenario for regexp_compile_in_hot_path: regexp.Compile or regexp.MustCompile observed inside obvious iterative paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.
var patterns = []string{`^\d+$`, `^[a-z]+$`, `^\w+@\w+\.\w+$`}

func scenario360Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	input := r.URL.Query().Get("value")
	for _, pattern := range patterns {
		re := regexp.MustCompile(pattern)
		if re.MatchString(input) {
			w.Write([]byte("matched " + pattern))
			return
		}
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusBadRequest)
}
